demo.cliff: an Actor that is only a place to put things
teaches: A stash is an Actor with six stored fields and no derived ones. Its contents are ordinary embedded Items, exactly as on a Traveller.
kind is a subtitle the sheet prints under the name — a locker, a cache, a hold, a room.
showWeight is what turns the weight column on, which a locker wants and a scene dressing does not.
locked hides the contents behind lockedDescription, which is what a player sees instead.
demo.trap: prototypeToken.actorLink is written here as true because _preCreate does not run for a packed document. A stash with an unlinked token is a stash whose contents fork the moment a second token is dropped, and nothing warns about it.

system.lockedDescription: A patrol seal on a steel door. The number is stencilled over an older number.
system.description: What the harbour patrol keeps at the quay rather than aboard: spare kit, a bag nobody has claimed, and the ammunition the office will not sign for twice.
system.notes: The seal is the patrol's. Breaking it is a matter for the Harbourmaster.

demo.trap: onHand is false here: the bag is in the locker rather than on a shoulder, which is what decides whether its contents count against anybody's encumbrance.

system.description: A patrol satchel: oilcloth, two buckles and a shoulder strap that has been replaced twice.

demo.trap: container.id names the field kit above, by id. A stash carries the same container graph a Traveller does.

system.description: Heavy slugs for the patrol sidearm. They hit harder and bite less deeply.
rules: A magazine of these holds eight rounds where the standard magazine holds twelve.

demo.trap: Its Active Effect is suppressed here as it is everywhere: a drug's effects are the template a swallowed dose copies, so a box in a locker changes nothing about anybody.

system.description: A patrol issue ampoule. It stops the shakes for an afternoon and charges for it afterwards.
system.afterEffect: Endurance falls by 1 until the next full night's sleep.

effects.name: Demo — Steadied
effects.description: The template a swallowed dose copies onto the Traveller: +2 DEX for the duration.
